meta.purpose: system design / pipeline evaluation, not model quality
meta.set_b: complex prompts stressing orchestration, chaining and failure modes

set_a_search_questions.query: What did Iran's supreme leader order the military to do on Oct 31, 2026?

set_a_search_questions.expected_answer: Mojtaba Khamenei, son of the late Ali Khamenei.

set_a_search_questions.expected_answer: An 11pm to 6am curfew around Place de la République and Châtelet-Les Halles.

set_a_search_questions.expected_answer: Nuñez, who announced the 70,000-officer deployment and warned of a 'very high risk' day.

set_a_search_questions.expected_answer: Karol Nawrocki, who was seen struggling to enter the court building during the standoff.
